departments.title: Departments

employees.title: Employees

users.title: Users & roles
users.help: Managers, owner, accountants and admins. Employee logins are created on the employee page. Users are deactivated, never deleted.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intact: ✔ Integrity check passed: all {count} events are linked and unmodified.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.hintTool: Click or drag across cells to fill.

schedule.copyConfirm: Copy last week's schedule onto this week? Existing cells this week are overwritten.
schedule.publish: Publish ({count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}})
schedule.footnote: Cost = paid hours × hourly rate × employer cost factor ({factor}). ✓ = day approved in Forma 76. “*” = legend changed after this day was planned. Amber dot = change employees can't see until you publish.
schedule.pdfHint: Download the shown period as PDF, with a legend of the hours
schedule.saveAsLegend: Save as a new legend for this department

schedule.customHelpNoSave: These hours appear in the legend with an automatic code (P1, P2…).

timesheet.sentForApproval: Sent to the top manager for approval
timesheet.unapprovedNote: {count} planned day(s) are not approved yet (shown grey in brackets). Only approved days count as actual.

corrections.title: Corrections of approved days
corrections.helpDecide: Approve or reject changes to days that were already approved.
corrections.helpManager: Changes you requested; the top manager decides.

budgets.title: Labour budgets
budgets.historyNote: Every change is kept in history; the latest value counts.
budgets.factorHelp: Gross hourly rate × factor = cost used in budgets. 1.19 ≈ gross pay + employer social contributions.
budgets.nothingToCopy: Nothing to copy (no previous budgets, or this month is already set)
budgets.factorNow: Current cost factor: {factor} (budgets are total cost = pay × factor).
budgets.changeFactor: Change it in the hotel profile

dashboard.title: Labour cost
dashboard.unapprovedWarning: ⚠ {count} past employee-day(s) are scheduled but not approved in Forma 76 – they are counted from the schedule.

dashboard.unpublishedWarning: {name}: {count} upcoming schedule changes are not published – staff don't see them yet.
dashboard.footnotePay: Actual = approved hours × hourly pay. Projected = actual + scheduled hours of days not yet approved. Estimates, not payroll.

advances.title: Salary advances
advances.onBehalf: Request on behalf of an employee
advances.flow: Request → approved by the manager or accounting → marked as given by accounting.
advances.context: This month: earned so far {earned} · advances already approved {advanced}

me.title: My schedule
me.notLinked: Your login is not linked to an employee record.
me.estimateNote: Estimate: approved and planned hours × your hourly pay, minus advances. The final amount is calculated by accounting.
me.nothingThisMonth: Nothing published for this month yet.
me.tableHelp: Tap one of your coming days to ask a colleague to swap it.
me.tableHelpTeam: Tap a colleague's day to ask them for a swap. Only published plans are shown.

team.title: Team
team.monthHours: This month: {approved} h approved + {planned} h planned

swaps.title: Shift swaps
swaps.managerHelp: A colleague has already agreed to each swap below. Approving exchanges the two plans, and both people see the change straight away.
swaps.ownNeedsOther: You take part in this swap – another manager or the GM has to decide.
swaps.newHelp: Exchange your plan with a colleague for one day, or for two days. Your colleague accepts first, then your manager approves.
swaps.noLogin: no app login – ask your manager
swaps.secondHelp: For example: they take your Thursday and you take their Saturday. On each day you exchange plans.
swaps.afterSend: Nothing changes until your colleague and your manager both agree.
swaps.acceptHelp: After you accept, the manager decides. Until then your schedule stays as it is.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.help: We'll send a link to your email or Telegram.
forgot.sentIfPossible: If your account has an email or Telegram, a link is on its way (valid 2 hours). No message? Ask your manager.

welcome.aboutLead: The app helps you plan staff, keep the daily timesheet and watch labour cost. In short:

plan.title: Plan
plan.text: managers build the schedule per location from shift legends

see.title: Staff see it
see.text: on their phone, with messages when it changes; they can swap shifts

forma.title: Forma 76
forma.text: every day the manager approves the hours really worked

cost.title: Cost
cost.text: you see labour cost against the budget for every department, live

owner.name: You (owner)
owner.text: hotel profile, budgets, the General Manager

staff.name: Staff
staff.text: their schedule, hours, swaps and advances

welcome.whoLead: Invite your General Manager to do it – or skip and do it yourself; the checklist will guide you.
welcome.ownerText: You're using the built-in admin account. Create your own owner login for daily use – you'll get a link to choose your password.
welcome.gmExists: A General Manager already has a login.
welcome.gmText: They get a link (and QR code) to choose their password, then can create the departments.
welcome.whoLater: You can do this later from Users & roles.
welcome.notifyLead: Invites, published schedules, swaps and decisions are sent by email and/or Telegram when these are set up.
welcome.notifyLater: Not required to start: without it you hand people their invite link or QR code. Setup steps are in Notifications.

guide.title: Guide
guide.lead: How the app fits together and what each person does in it.
guide.flowTitle: From an empty hotel to the first schedule

owner.title: Owner
owner.text: Hotel profile (name, cost factor) and the General Manager's login.

departments.title: Departments
departments.text: The owner or GM creates each department with its manager (the manager gets an invite).

manager.title: Manager sets up
manager.text: Locations (restaurants, bars…), roles, staffing needs per place and time, shift legends.

staff.title: Staff
staff.text: The manager adds people (or pastes them from Excel) and sends invites or prints QR slips.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.text: Plan per location, check gaps against the needs, publish – staff get a message.

daily.title: Every day
daily.text: Approve Forma 76 hours; swaps and advances come in as requests; the dashboard shows cost vs budget.

owner.title: Owner
owner.one: Sets the hotel profile and the cost factor (only the total budget uses it).
owner.two: Creates the GM and, if wanted, departments and managers.
owner.four: Sees pay and total cost of every department.

top_manager.title: General Manager
top_manager.one: Creates departments and their managers, sets seasons.
top_manager.two: Follows each department's setup on the progress board.
top_manager.three: Decides Forma 76 corrections and can approve swaps.

manager.title: Department manager
manager.one: Sets up locations, roles, staffing needs and legends.
manager.two: Adds staff, sets their pay, sends invites.
manager.three: Plans and publishes the schedule, approves Forma 76 daily.
manager.four: Approves swaps and advances of the department.

accountant.title: Accountant
accountant.two: Uses hours by role for different pay rates.
accountant.three: Approves advances and marks them as given.

employee.title: Staff
employee.one: Sees their shifts after the manager publishes.
employee.two: Sees their hours and an estimate of their pay.

publish.q: Why don't staff see my schedule?
publish.a: Changes are visible only after Publish. An amber dot marks changes not published yet.

swap.a: The employee asks a colleague, the colleague accepts, the department manager approves – then both schedules change.

forma.a: The daily record of hours really worked. Approved days are locked; changes go to the GM as corrections.

advance.a: Requested by the employee (or the manager), approved by the manager or accounting, then marked as given by accounting.

pdf.a: Yes – the PDF button on the schedule prints the shown week or month, for one location or all, with a legend of the hours.

password.a: They use “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page, or the manager sends a reset link from the employee page.

help.dashboard: Labour cost of the month against the budget, per department. Managers see pay; owner, GM and accounting can switch to total cost.
help.departments: Create departments and give each a manager. The manager gets an invite and then sets up their own department.
help.employees: The people of your department(s): position, usual place, hourly pay and login. Invites go by email/Telegram or on printed slips.
help.hotel: The hotel's name and language, the cost factor for total budgets, and seasons for staffing needs.
help.import: Copy rows from Excel and paste them here. Check the preview, then create everyone at once.
help.me: Your coming shifts, your hours and pay this month, swaps and advances.
help.needs: For each location: how many people of each role are needed, from when to when. Rules can be for some weekdays, a season or one date.
help.progress: How far each department is with its setup – click any cell to open that step.
help.setup: The places of the department (each gets its own schedule), the roles people work as, and everyone's position and usual place.
help.shifts: Shift legends are the shifts you pick in the schedule. Managers add their department's; the owner/GM the hotel-wide ones.
